ad_info.reference_style: Clean, modern three-stage progress ad: three circular photo frames of increasing size threaded on one horizontal timeline, showing the same woman growing in energy and confidence, with the product anchoring the bottom
ad_info.angle_used: Rutina / momento de uso: the 3-month natural curves plan

global_identity.color_palette: Primary: hot fuchsia #E6177F and deep magenta #B0105E. Secondary: bottle black #0E0E10, bubblegum pink #FF8CC0, pale blush pink #FBE3EE, white #FFFFFF, and aguaje orange #D9572B only for fruit accents.
global_identity.visual_style: Premium Latin American beauty-supplement ad: clean pink and blush backgrounds, ultra-photorealistic Colombian women photographed naturally and respectfully, the black-and-fuchsia bottle as hero, clean icon modules.
global_identity.visual_atmosphere: Feminine, confident, warm and aspirational; soft daylight, believable real-life moments.
global_identity.graphic_language: Rounded pills and banners in fuchsia and deep magenta, thin-line white icons inside fuchsia circles, handwritten script accents used sparingly, clean flat or softly graded backgrounds with minimal decoration (no clutter, no excess particles, petals or sparkles).
global_identity.text_typography: Poppins Bold (uppercase, heavy) for headlines and labels, Poppins Regular for supporting text, and a casual handwritten script for short emotional accents.

creative_objective: Present the product as a clear 3-month plan for her curves. The timeline shows the same woman, from the shoulders up, growing in energy and confidence month by month (never body changes), so the viewer understands it is a process and wants the full plan.

art_direction.design_quality: Premium, polished, modern, scroll-stopping, professionally designed, commercially strong
art_direction.visual_hierarchy: 1) Bold headline at the top. 2) The three circular portraits read left to right as growth: small, medium, large, the largest ringed in fuchsia. 3) The bottle centered in the bottom band. 4) The month pills and the short captions.
art_direction.composition_style: Horizontal left-to-right progression with deliberate size growth. Circle centers on one line at about 46% of the height: circle 1 about 20% of the width (centered at 17%), circle 2 about 25% (centered at 43%), circle 3 about 32% (centered at 75%). A thin timeline track runs behind them with a small chevron in each gap. Pills straddle the top edge of each circle; captions on a shared baseline below; the bottle centered in the bottom band.
art_direction.spacing_and_structure: Headline 6-19% of the height; circles between 30% and 62%; captions 65-71%; product band 74-95%. Safe margins of 6-7% on every side.
art_direction.lighting_and_depth: Inside the circles: identical head-and-shoulders crop, camera angle and lighting setup; stage 1 slightly cooler and muted, stage 2 neutral, stage 3 warmest and most vibrant. Thin white outline and soft drop shadow on each circle; circle 3 with a hot fuchsia ring and faint glow. Bottle with soft studio key light from the upper left, subtle rim light and soft contact shadow.
art_direction.conversion_feel: The ad must feel persuasive, eye-catching, emotionally engaging, credible, elegant and commercially strong

reference_structure_analysis.layout_summary: Square canvas with a flat pale blush pink background. Headline centered at the top. Across the middle, three circular head-and-shoulders photos of the same Colombian woman grow in size left to right along a thin horizontal timeline track with a chevron arrow in each gap. A rounded month pill sits on the top edge of each circle, the largest circle is ringed in hot fuchsia. A short caption sits under each circle on a shared baseline. The product bottle stands centered in the bottom band with a soft shadow.
